newsitem.title: USA: Hot Topic Q4 sales jump 65 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hot Topic Q4 sales jump 65 pct.

text.p: Hot Topic Inc said Wednesday sales for its fourth quarter increased 65 percent from the comparable year-ago period.
Fourth quarter net sales were $16,429,000 up from $9,958,000 for the comparable period of fiscal 1995. Same store sales increased 7.4 percent compared with the fourth quarter last year.
Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 1 were $43,618,000, up 85 percent from $23,632,000 for fiscal 1995. Same store sales rose 8.9 percent for the year.

During fiscal 1996, the company opened 26 new stores and operated 68 stores at the end of the fiscal year, compared with 42 at the end of fiscal 1995. The company said in a statement its plan to open 40 stores in 1997 is on track.
